basis: Stand-in sweep on the CPU delegate, Apple M4 Pro, Chromium 159, run label standin-cpu in results.json. Measured: roll slope 1.006, gain x 0.996, gain y 0.987 (from 4 and 17 samples, so wider), rendered over face 1.059 at the still clip and 3.5 percent at most across zoom, gated share 0.139 over all conditions and 0 over still, roll and dx, bridge offset 0.072 of the interocular distance. Slopes and gains have truth 1 and get 10 percent (15 percent for gain y); the rest get 1.4 to 2.3 times the measured value. Timing is not gated: runner hardware changes it without a code change.
